sentences.text: Pastaj ai shkoi në shtëpinë e Dritës.
sentences.english: Then he went to Drita's house.
Sam does not go out of the house.
He drinks coffee in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Pastaj ai fillon të shkruajë një letër.
sentences.english: Then he begins to write a letter.

sentences.text: Ai mendon për Ardin dhe Dritën.
sentences.english: He thinks about Ardi and Drita.

sentences.text: Jetoj në një shtëpi të vogël.
sentences.english: I live in a small house.

sentences.text: Pi kafe me Luanin dhe Anën.
sentences.english: I drink coffee with Luan and Ana.

sentences.text: Lexoj Biblën çdo ditë. Ajo flet për dashurinë e Perëndisë.
sentences.english: I read the Bible every day. It speaks of the love of God.
I love you very much. Sam."

sentences.text: Ardi ka një letër nga gjyshi.
sentences.english: Ardi has a letter from his grandfather.

sentences.text: Gjyshi shkruan: «I dashur Ardi, si je?
sentences.english: The grandfather writes: "Dear Ardi, how are you?
I am well in the village.
I love you very much. Grandfather."

sentences.text: Ardi e merr letrën dhe e shikon.
sentences.english: Ardi takes the letter and looks at it.
Then he gives it to his grandmother.

sentences.text: Elira i shkroi një letër gjyshes.
sentences.english: Elira wrote a letter to her grandmother.

sentences.text: Gjergji më dha një libër të ri.
sentences.english: Gjergj gave me a new book.
Elira gave the letter to the mother.
The mother read it and smiled.
